rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for work or jobs involving office clerical duties.

example.english: This clerical job mainly involves helping to handle documents.
example.traditional: 呢份文職工作主要係幫手處理文件。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man4 zik1 gung1 zok3 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 bong1 sau2 cyu5 lei5 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this for matters relating specifically to clergy or religious office rather than office administration.

example.english: They decided to enter the clerical profession and serve the church.
example.traditional: 佢決定投身神職，服侍教會。
example.jyutping: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 tau4 san1 san4 zik1 fuk6 si6 gaau3 wui6
